title: Add an IMAPI2 transport that needs no administrator rights
body:
## What

`discprobe/imapi.py` adds `ImapiDevice`, a drop-in for `SptiDevice` that sends the same CDBs through Windows' own IMAPI2 recorder (`IDiscRecorder2Ex`). A standard user may call it, so no elevated terminal is needed.

- New common option `--transport {auto,spti,imapi}`. `auto` (the default) keeps SPTI and falls back to IMAPI2 when SPTI is refused with access denied.
- README, README.en and MANUAL mention it, and the SPTI access-denied hint points to it.

## How

- Standard library only (ctypes).
- MsftDiscMaster2 and MsftDiscRecorder2 are reached through IDispatch (GetIDsOfNames + Invoke), so nothing depends on their vtable order. Only IDiscRecorder2Ex slots 3 (SendCommandNoData) and 5 (SendCommandGetDataFromDevice) are called directly.
- Same contract as `SptiDevice`: the `scsi.py` allowlist is checked first, data-out is refused, and `perf_counter_ns()` is taken right around the COM call.
- IMAPI2 reports a CHECK CONDITION as the success code S_IMAPI_COMMAND_HAS_SENSE_DATA (0x00AA0200), with the sense bytes in the caller's buffer. That becomes status 0x02 plus the parsed sense. A failing HRESULT raises OSError, as a failing DeviceIoControl does.
- The recorder is held with AcquireExclusiveAccess and media-change notification is disabled for the run. Both are undone on close.

## Tested

HP BD-RE BU20N (USB, firmware 0403), Windows 11, standard user:
- `list` and `info` give the same report through both transports, including the drive's sense codes for refused commands.
- `timing` on a CD-DA disc at `--speed 1411`, run back to back over SPTI and IMAPI2 (together with the `readcd-usb-cache` PR, needed for CD-DA on this drive):
  - both: CAV, period 48.3485 ms in all three zones;
  - jitter: SPTI 55–62 µs, IMAPI2 43–63 µs;
  - the 5 target phases differ by −0.31…+0.28° (χ² 10.0 for 5 dof), about the run-to-run scatter on this drive.
- `selftest` passes (numpy parts skipped), also merged with current main.

Not exercised: on this machine SPTI also opened the drive without elevation, so the automatic fallback was only reached with `--transport imapi`.

The two timing summaries are in [WindowsNoEditor/disc-probe@dis-cd-timing](https://github.com/WindowsNoEditor/disc-probe/tree/dis-cd-timing/contrib/dis-cd-timing/out/discprobe_spti_vs_imapi).

title: timing: catch slow cache hits for READ CD, where there is no FUA
body:
## Problem

On an HP BD-RE BU20N over USB, plain READ CD re-reads of one CD-DA sector come back from the drive's cache in about 9.8 ms, above `CACHE_HIT_US` (3 ms).

- For READ(12) the FUA comparison catches slow cache hits. READ CD has no FUA, so that check never runs.
- The cache test therefore chose `plain`, the period test timed cache hits (coherence about 0.4, "Rotation: unknown"), and the phase test was skipped.

## Fix

- For READ CD, the cache test also times reads that follow an eviction (`max(8, reads // 4)` of them). If those are at least `CACHE_RATIO` times slower than plain reads, plain reads count as cached.
- The cache-hit threshold is then raised to the geometric mean of the two medians (`cache_hit_us`, also written to the cache summary).
- The flush check and `_usable()` use that threshold, so 10 ms hits are neither taken as a working flush nor kept as samples.
- Data discs, and drives whose cache hits are fast, behave as before.

## Before and after

Same disc and drive (HP BU20N, CD-DA, `--speed 1411`):
- Before: strategy `plain`; the zone "periods" were 4.86, 3.35 and 9.67 ms with coherence about 0.4; Rotation unknown; phase test skipped.
- After (`--evict-sectors 54 --reps 32`): plain p50 9.8 ms, after eviction 176 ms, so strategy `evict` (after a zero-length FUA flush still 9.8 ms, so flush is not used). CAV at 48.3485 ms in all three zones, jitter 55–62 µs, all 5 phase targets measured.
- `selftest` passes (numpy parts skipped), also merged with current main.

The default `--evict-sectors 1024` should behave the same; I only timed 54.

title: geo: measure a CD picture burned by DiscImageStudio (CD-DA track)
body:
First of the three PRs discussed in [DiscImageStudio #107](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107): `geo --media cd` can now measure the disc DiscImageStudio itself burned.

## What

DiscImageStudio burns a CD picture as one audio track (CD-DA). On such a disc, `geo --media cd` now:

- reads with READ CD, and times each sector against DiscImageStudio's own origin: sector k ends at byte 2352 (k + 1) of the burned audio stream, 24.5 channel bits per byte. So `u` and `v` are directly the ri and pitch DiscImageStudio uses, and `summary.json` gives `dis_equivalent` (ri, ro for the disc's sector count). The 108-frame read tail and the 206-frame along-track constant of the Mode 2 path don't apply.
- takes `--read-offset-bytes x`, the one constant left: where this drive's READ CD completes, x bytes before the end of the sector (HP BU20N 0, PLDS DU-8A5LH −603). It's written to `summary.json` with the origin and a note. Timing can't see it, so it needs one check per drive with a burned straight line, as you suggested.
- defaults to 1.25–99 % of the recorded area, since a picture fills the disc.

The Mode 2 data path is unchanged, and so is `timing`: it still refuses an audio track. Only `geo` passes `cd_audio=True` to `TimingProbe`.

## Cache

READ CD has no FUA, and READ(12) is illegal on audio, so there's no flush test. On an audio track, every timed read follows a read a third of the disc away (strategy `far`). This is also used when plain re-reads look uncached, because the read-ahead after one sector can cover a target only a fraction of a turn away.

`_cache_test_audio` checks that reads after a far read really come from the disc. If they don't, it tries 2, then 4 far reads, each 5000 sectors apart. Only if 4 aren't enough does it fall back to the existing eviction. In the simulator, the 1024-sector eviction made each ladder block long enough for the reference period fit to alias, so it stays the last resort.

On the BU20N: plain re-reads took 9.8 ms (cache), reads after one far read took 271 ms, so `cache_hit_us` was 51.6 ms and one far read was enough. The 36-rung run took 21 minutes.

## Simulator and selftest

- `SimDrive(media="cd", cd_audio=True, cd_read_offset_bytes=x)` models a CD-DA disc: an audio TOC entry, READ CD only (READ(10)/(12) get 5/64/00), and completion at the end of the sector minus x. It defaults to a single read-ahead segment (3 blocks).
- The CLI gains `--sim cav-audio` (with `--media cd`).
- New checks in `_ladder_cd_audio`, all passing:
  - A banana-like spiral (ri 24.911653 mm, pitch 1.4926 µm) with a −603-byte offset: 24 rungs with far reads give ri +12 nm and ro −13 nm from the truth.
  - Leaving the offset at 0 moves ri by +51 nm (expected +39 nm from `u² − v d / π`).
  - A 6-block cache needs 2 far reads; ri is then +3 nm from the truth. A 40-block cache falls back to eviction.
  - `timing --media cd` still refuses an audio track, and `--read-offset-bytes` is refused on a data CD.

## Tested on hardware

HP BD-RE BU20N over USB, Windows 11, `geo --drive E: --media cd` with defaults (1411 kB/s, 1241 rpm), 36 rungs, about 21 minutes each. Two probe discs burned by DiscImageStudio, both ATIP 97:27:18 and 359849 sectors. Each is compared with an independent C# ladder plus `calibrate_pitch.py` ([dis-cd-timing](https://github.com/WindowsNoEditor/disc-probe/tree/dis-cd-timing/contrib/dis-cd-timing)) on the same disc and drive:

| disc | this `geo`: ri / ro (mm) | C# ladder: ri / ro (mm) | difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| banana CD-R | 24.911658547 / 57.931588268 | 24.911653498 / 57.931592419 | +5.0 / −4.2 nm |
| Haicun POSO CD-R | 24.911758372 / 57.931710707 | 24.911761919 / 57.931708318 (two runs) | −3.5 / +2.4 nm |

- The C# values have statistical errors of about 3 nm (banana) and 1.6 nm (POSO).
- Discs burned with the C# values came out right: the banana verification disc has straight spokes, and pictures burned on a PLDS DU-8A5LH look undistorted.
- The two disc types share an ATIP code but not a geometry. This `geo` finds banana −100 nm (ri) and −122 nm (ro) from POSO; the C# ladder finds −108 and −116 nm.

## Not covered

- `selftest` here: I ran it with Blender's bundled Python (numpy 2.3, no scipy or Pillow). Everything up to the end of `cd_selftest`'s ladder checks passes, including the existing CD data-path ladder tests. The `disexport` checks (scipy) and the CD ring-scan and scan checks (Pillow) couldn't run here; this branch doesn't touch them. The plain-Python run (no numpy) passes everything it reaches.
- Other drives: only the BU20N was run through this path. The PLDS offset of −603 comes from my C# ladder, not from this code.
- `disexport` isn't changed here. That's PR 2.

## Something I noticed, for a separate PR if you want it

On the BU20N single reads scatter by about 3–4° (standard deviation) in both programs. Two things in `measure` let that through: `analysis.phase_offsets` subtracts the interpolated residual of the neighbouring reference reads from every target, and `robust_circular_mean` clips only the targets, at 5×MAD. So reference outliers reach the targets. My C# ladder clips the references and the targets at 4×MAD around the median and fits only a linear drift over the block. On the same disc it gets a per-rung σ of 0.20° and a residual rms of 0.19°, against 0.46° and 1.24° here. That changes results on every drive, DVD included, so I left it out. Happy to send it separately with before/after numbers.

title: cdprobe: write a DiscImageStudio project and pattern for a CD probe disc
body:
Third of the three PRs from [DiscImageStudio #107](https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio/discussions/107): a small command that writes what to burn for a CD probe disc. It's independent of #7: it only writes files, and doesn't touch `geo`.

## What

```
python -m discprobe cdprobe --sectors 359849
python -m discprobe cdprobe --sectors 359849 --radii 24.9118 57.9317
```

This writes `dis/cd-probe-<sectors>.discproj` and the pattern next to it as `.png`.

- **Project:** DiscImageStudio's `.discproj`, schema 2, field for field as v1.4.0–v1.5.0 read it (their `ProjectJsonStore` rejects unknown fields; v1.5.0's optional `usableSectors` is left out).
  - CD, with the radii and the sector count. The pitch terms are 0: a probe disc doesn't need them (v1.5.0 uses them for CD; earlier releases ignore them).
  - One layer: the pattern, at 100 %, with no offset or rotation.
  - 2 tone levels without dither, interleave on, output `<stem>.wav` next to the project.
- **Burn values:** inner radius 24.92 mm, and the outer radius that gives a 1.4865 µm pitch over the given sector count (typical of the 80-minute CD-Rs measured so far). `--radii` takes a similar disc type's values. These values only affect how readable the pattern is: the measurement is of the burned disc.
- **Pattern:** a greyscale PNG drawn for the project's band, since a layer at 100 % spans ±ro (`DesignLayerViewModel.LoadImage`). Black on white, data side, unmirrored:
  - 12 spokes;
  - a ring every 5 mm and at each edge, with a tick at 10° on each ring, so spoke 0 can be followed ring by ring on a twisted disc;
  - a polar "F" that reads normally from the data side, so a mirrored photo shows at once;
  - the half band from 105° to 285° inverted, as a twist gauge. Spokes fade once the burn values are about 1 µm off; the gauge's edges then wind into a two-start spiral, visible up to about 100 µm off.
  - The feature list is stored as JSON in a tEXt chunk (`DiscImageStudio-probe-pattern`), for tools that predict or check the burned disc.

It's pure standard library. The pattern code is the one behind the banana and POSO probe discs: for the same band the PNG is byte-identical.

## Also in this PR

- `cdprobe` sits under "Use elsewhere" next to `disexport`, with Chinese for the description, the options, the messages and the help paragraph.
- A `guide.after_cdprobe` hint, and a MANUAL section in the CD part.
- `selftest`, in a new `_cdprobe` that needs no numpy:
  - the project has exactly DiscImageStudio's CD project fields;
  - the generic values are right (ri 24.92 mm, pitch 1.4865 µm);
  - the PNG header and its feature list match the project's band;
  - pixels are correct on a spoke, on the background, and in the inverted half;
  - a bad sector count, non-CD radii and an existing project are refused.

## Tested

- `selftest` on current main (Blender's Python with numpy, no scipy or Pillow here): every check up to the first scipy-only one passes, including the five `cdprobe` checks; `_chinese` and `_completion` pass when run directly.
- DiscImageStudio v1.4.0 and v1.5.0 open the generated project: `ui-snapshot --project … --tab 1` renders the design page with the layer at 100 %, offset 0, rotation 0, and no loader complaint.
- Earlier probe discs made from the same pattern code (banana, POSO) were burned on an HP BU20N, and `geo --media cd` measured them (see #7).

title: feat(geo_polyfit): joint analysis of repeated geo runs of one disc
body:
## What

`tools/geo_polyfit.py` 现在可以把同一张盘的多次 `geo` 测量合在一起分析。

- **联合拟合**：各次测量共用 u、v 和轨距系数，每次测量有自己的相位常数。
- **模型选择**：用加权嵌套模型 F 检验比较恒定、二次、三次轨距。phi 的留一法表格基于合并后的数据，每一折都重新拟合各次测量的偏移。
- **判定**：针对实际使用的模型给出。修正值得做时是所选修正，否则是恒定轨距。
  - `run consistency`：比较"所有测量共用一次拟合"和"每次测量各自拟合"的 F 检验。只给出 `conflict`（有冲突）或 `no conflict found`（未发现冲突），从不断言测量一致。
  - `agreement`：每两次测量各自的修正，在共同测量范围内取最差半径处的切向差，用 2σ 上下界与 `--tolerance-mm` 比较（默认 0.3 mm，粗略经验值）。结果为 `within`（在容差内）、`beyond`（超出容差）或 `inconclusive`（证据不足）。
  - `suggest another run`（建议再测一次）：有冲突时，或合并后的 2σ 误差带超出容差时给出。
  - 使用 `--phi-degree` 时，检验对象是 phi 多项式本身。
- **`--write-summary`**：写出合并后的恒定轨距 summary，供 `disexport` / `image --geo` 使用。多次测量时，`--write-correction` 必须搭配它，修正文件记录合并后的 `geo_fit`。
- **防护**：
  - 同一个测量文件夹给两次，或两次测量的 `targets.csv` 内容相同，会被拒绝。
  - 会覆盖某次测量的 `targets.csv`、`summary.json`、`events.csv` 的输出，以及两个输出指向同一文件，都会被拒绝。
  - 合并 summary 保留 `"simulated": true`。
  - 某次来源测量中途停止或未完成时，这个状态会带进合并 summary，`disexport --install` 会像拒绝那次测量一样拒绝它。

只给一个文件夹时，输出和修正文件与 `main` 逐字节相同。

## Why

要判断盘的轨距是真的弯曲还是测量噪声，需要重复测量。此前只能手动比较。

单一的"reproducible: yes/no"标签容易误导：
- F 检验没有拒绝，不等于测量一致；
- 固定的 twist 门槛没有考虑噪声。

现在的判定把"测量之间是否冲突"和"是否在容差内一致"分开，并允许"证据不足"。

## Tested

我在 HL-DT-ST GHB0N（Linux）上的真实数据：

| 数据 | 一致性 p | Agreement（0.3 mm） | 建议再测 |
|---|---|---|---|
| RITEK DVD-R，2 次，三次轨距 | 0.259 | 证据不足（54 mm 处最差 0.23 mm，1σ 0.18 mm） | 否 |
| RITEK DVD+RW，8x 下 2 次，三次轨距 | 0.461 | 证据不足（0.27 / 0.19 mm） | 是：误差带只在 56.8 mm 以内达标，全长到 57.2 mm |
| 同一张 DVD+RW，3 次，含一次停在第 9 级的 | 0.563 | 证据不足 | 否 |
| 同一张 DVD+RW，4x 对 8x | 0.922 | 证据不足（0.12 / 0.21 mm） | 否 |
| 两张不同的盘 | 6e-134 | 超出容差 | 是 |

- 用合并后的 DVD+RW 拟合导出预设，在 DiscImageStudio 中刻出的线是直的。不加修正时，偏差约 2 mm。
- 单次测量：默认、`--order cubic`、`--phi-degree 4` 三种情况，输出和修正文件都与 `main` 逐字节相同。
- 变基到最新 `main` 前后，多次测量的输出不变，只是修正文件多了新的 `geo_fit` 字段。
- `image` 的 `correction_other_run` 接受合并修正文件与对应的合并 summary 搭配使用。
- 来源测量为中途停止或 `candidates_exhausted` 时，`install_blocker` 会拒绝合并 summary。
- 在本地运行的固定种子统计检查：
  - 同一条恒定螺旋的冲突率接近名义水平（α=0.01 时 60 对中最多 3 对）；
  - 弯曲螺旋用它自己的阶数检验时不报冲突；
  - 不同的盘报冲突，并判为超出容差；
  - 精确的测量判为在容差内，噪声大的测量判为证据不足；
  - phi 路径能区分一张盘和两张盘；
  - 重复、复制和会覆盖文件的输入都被拒绝。

## Not Covered

- **本 PR 不含测试文件**：`tools/` 没有测试框架。
- **外圈边缘**：真实数据两两比较，在 0.3 mm 下都判为证据不足，原因是单次测量在最外几级（约 54 mm）附近不确定度最大。这可能需要从测量流程改进，比如在外圈多测几级，而不是放宽阈值。
- **0.3 mm 容差**：依据只有一台光驱、两张盘和一次刻录对比。
- **来源测量的 chi2 上限**：不继承，合并 summary 按自身的联合拟合判断。
- **未实测**：
  - 多次测量的 CD 数据，代码已支持，但没用真实光盘测过；
  - `image --geo` 搭配合并 summary；
  - Windows 平台实际表现。

---

## What

`tools/geo_polyfit.py` can analyse several `geo` runs of the same disc together.

- **Joint fit.** All runs share u, v and the pitch coefficients, with one phase constant per run.
- **Model choice.** Constant, quadratic and cubic pitch are compared with a weighted nested-model F-test. The phi leave-one-out table is pooled, with per-run offsets refitted in every fold.
- **Verdicts.** They are reported for the model in use: the chosen correction if it is worthwhile, otherwise the constant pitch.
  - `run consistency`: an F-test of one shared fit against one fit per run. It reports `conflict` or `no conflict found`, never that the runs agree.
  - `agreement`: each pair of runs' own corrections, compared tangentially at the worst radius of their common span, using a 2-sigma bound against `--tolerance-mm` (default 0.3 mm, a rough empirical value). The result is `within`, `beyond` or `inconclusive`.
  - `suggest another run`: on a conflict, or where the merged 2-sigma band exceeds the tolerance.
  - With `--phi-degree`, the tests use the phi polynomial itself.
- **`--write-summary`** writes a merged constant-pitch summary for `disexport` / `image --geo`. With several runs, `--write-correction` requires it, and the correction records the merged `geo_fit`.
- **Guards.**
  - A run folder given twice, or two runs with identical `targets.csv`, is refused.
  - Outputs that would overwrite a run's `targets.csv`, `summary.json` or `events.csv`, or that name the same file twice, are refused.
  - The merged summary keeps `"simulated": true`.
  - It also carries over a stopped or partial source run, so `disexport --install` refuses it as it would that run.

With one folder, output and correction files are byte-identical to `main`.

## Why

Telling whether a disc's pitch really curves, rather than measurement noise, needs repeated runs. Until now they could only be compared by hand.

A single "reproducible: yes/no" label was misleading:
- a non-rejected F-test is not evidence of agreement;
- a fixed twist threshold ignores noise.

The verdicts now keep "do the runs conflict" apart from "do they agree within a tolerance", and allow "inconclusive".

## Tested

On real data from my HL-DT-ST GHB0N (Linux):

| Data | Consistency p | Agreement (0.3 mm) | Suggest another run |
|---|---|---|---|
| RITEK DVD-R, 2 runs, cubic | 0.259 | inconclusive (worst 0.23 mm, 1 sigma 0.18 mm at 54 mm) | no |
| RITEK DVD+RW, 2 runs at 8x, cubic | 0.461 | inconclusive (0.27 / 0.19 mm) | yes: band within 0.3 mm only up to 56.8 of 57.2 mm |
| Same DVD+RW, 3 runs incl. one stopped at 9 rungs | 0.563 | inconclusive | no |
| Same DVD+RW, 4x vs 8x | 0.922 | inconclusive (0.12 / 0.21 mm) | no |
| Two different discs | 6e-134 | beyond | yes |

- A preset exported from the merged DVD+RW fit burned straight in DiscImageStudio. Without the correction, the lines would be off by about 2 mm.
- Single run: default, `--order cubic` and `--phi-degree 4` match `main` byte for byte, outputs and correction files alike.
- The merged multi-run output did not change across the rebase onto the latest `main`, except for the new `geo_fit` in correction files.
- `image`'s `correction_other_run` accepts a merged correction together with its merged summary.
- `install_blocker` refuses a merged summary whose source run is stopped or `candidates_exhausted`.
- Fixed-seed statistical checks, run locally:
  - one constant spiral conflicts at about the nominal rate (at most 3 of 60 pairs at alpha 0.01);
  - a curved spiral does not conflict in its own order;
  - different discs conflict and fall `beyond`;
  - precise runs fall `within`, and noisy runs fall `inconclusive`;
  - the phi path tells one disc from two;
  - repeated, copied and overwriting inputs are refused.

## Not Covered

- **No test file in this PR.** `tools/` has no test harness.
- **Outer edge.** On real pairs, `agreement` is `inconclusive` at 0.3 mm, because single runs are least certain near their outermost rungs, around 54 mm. This probably needs work on the measurement side, such as more outer rungs, rather than a looser threshold.
- **The 0.3 mm tolerance** rests on one drive, two discs and one burned comparison.
- **Chi2 limit of source runs.** It is not inherited: the merged summary is judged by its own joint fit.
- **Not exercised:**
  - multi-run CD data, which is handled in code but untested on a real disc;
  - `image --geo` with a merged summary;
  - Windows.

title: disexport: 直接把导出的预设写进 DiscImageStudio
body:
## 做了什么

- `disexport` 新增 `--install`：把导出的 preset 直接合并进 DiscImageStudio 的用户预设文件 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DiscImageStudio\disc-presets.json`（可用 `--dis-presets PATH` 指定路径），写完打印重启 DiscImageStudio 的提示。
- 读取时兼容 DIS 允许的 `//`、`/* */` 注释和尾逗号；旧的 schemaVersion 2/3 会升级到 4；同一个 id 且取值完全相同时不改文件，取值不同则拒绝，需要 `--replace`。
- 写前把原文件备份为 `.bak`，然后用同目录临时文件加原子替换写入；文件不存在时新建一个 schema 4 的空文档。
- 预设先按 DIS 的规则校验（id、半径、扇区数、三个轨距项；轨距多项式必须在 [0, 1] 上保持为正），避免写进一个 DIS 打不开的文件。
- `--dis-presets` / `--replace` 单独使用会报错；`--install` 是显式选项，脚本和管道里不会自动触发。
- README（中英）、docs/MANUAL.md、中文输出和帮助文本同步更新。

## 为什么

目前预设要手动填进 DIS，或者自己改 `disc-presets.json`（MANUAL 里写了这个办法，但我们没试过）。这个选项把最后一步接上，CD 路线导出后可以马上在 DIS 里精细标定。

## 验证

- `python -m discprobe selftest` 的 `DiscImageStudio preset install` 8 项、`preset export` 5 项全部通过。
- `ui_selftest` 除仓库原有的 `colour: it goes back to the terminal's colour` 失败外全部通过；该失败在干净的 5159148 上同样出现。
- 完整 `selftest` 仍会在原有的 CD ladder 处中止（`RuntimeError: no room for a rung 1.5 turns from the reference`），干净 5159148 上也能复现，与本改动无关。
- 用真实 `disc-presets.json` 的副本试装了示例预设：升级到 schema 4、生成 `.bak`，真实文件的 SHA256 保持不变。

示例：

```powershell
python -m discprobe disexport --geo latest --sectors 2295104 --install
```

重启 DiscImageStudio 后即可在预设列表里选到。没有修改 DiscImageStudio 仓库。

Pushed a rework of the install path; all five points are addressed, and the two selftest failures are now explained.

**1. `--output` and `--dis-presets` naming one file.** `cmd_disexport` now compares the two targets before the export writes anything (`disinstall.same_file`: `os.path.samefile` when both exist, `normcase(realpath())` when one does not), and exits before `export()` runs. Checked on a copy of a real file: the refusal prints and the file's sha1 is unchanged.

**2. Results that should not become a preset.** `guide.install_blocker()` runs between reading the geo result and the export, so `--install` refuses three kinds of run and says why: a simulated one (the `SIM` result folder), one that stopped before the fit (`stopped` in summary.json), and one `results` already calls unusable (fewer than 8 rungs, chi2/dof above 25, or angles known to worse than 0.6°). CD-DA results are not refused — they go through the same checks and install normally, since that is what DiscImageStudio's audio path consumes.

**3. Backups.** `disc-presets.json.<YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS>.bak`, and a name already taken gets `-1`, `-2`, … So the first backup is always the file as it was before the first install; later installs no longer overwrite it. Tested by installing twice.

**4. Comments and trailing commas.** The rewrite is still plain JSON, but the install now says what it dropped: `Rewrote the file as plain JSON, so its comments and trailing commas are not kept.` Both READMEs and `docs/MANUAL.md` say the same, and the messages have Chinese translations.

**5. Unclosed `/*`.** `_strip_comments` now looks for the closing `*/` with `str.find` and raises when there is none; the install fails with `has a /* comment with no closing */; the file was left alone`, and a selftest case asserts the bytes are untouched.

**6. Schema and validation, checked against your source.** I read `DiscPresetJsonStore.cs`: schema 2 predates the BD catalog, schema 3 dropped `linearVelocityMmPerSecond` and `channelBitLengthNm`, schema 4 adds `bluRayPresets`. Our migration does the same thing (fill the missing lists, keep every other field, bump to 4) and keeps schema 3's presets readable. `UsableSectors` is `long?`/`uint?` with `JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull` on your side, so I made the same-values test compare only the fields this tool writes, and `--replace` now merges into the existing preset instead of replacing it whole. That keeps `usableSectors`, `contributor`, `displayNameResourceKey` and the pitch polynomial intact. I have not run DIS 1.5.0 (the only file here is schema 4 from an earlier version and has no `usableSectors`), so this is by inspection, not by test.

**7. The `no room for a rung 1.5 turns from the reference` failure.** It reproduces here and it is a Windows bug, not a ladder-geometry one: `cd.read_end_bits()` builds `np.asarray(...)` without a dtype, numpy's default integer is int32 on Windows, and `(352000+1)*98+108)*588` ≈ 2.03e10 overflows. `read_end_bits(352000)` returns `-1191067352` where the true value is `20283769128` (`cd.py:158` also emits `RuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in scalar multiply` first). Fix is `dtype=np.int64` plus a regression case; I left it out of this PR since it belongs to the CD work, and I can open a separate one — say the word.

The `colour` failure no longer reproduces here, which matches your float-boundary theory.

Environment: Windows 11 (10.0.26300), Python 3.12.2, numpy 1.26.4. `selftest` reaches 144 `ok` with no FAIL and then hits the int32 crash above; `ui_selftest` passes.

title: cd: keep bit positions past 2**31 exact on 32-bit NumPy
body:
上次说的 int32 溢出，单独开在这里，顺便把同类的地方一起查了。

## 问题是这两处

`cd.py` 里只有两个函数接收纯 Python int 然后直接乘、没写 dtype：

- `read_end_bits()`（`cd.py:158`）：`(lba + 1) * 98 * 588`。最后一张 CD 扇区的末位是 2.03e10 位，`read_end_bits(352000)` 返回 **-1191067352**，正确值 20283769128。
- `channel_position()`（`cd.py:132`）：`frame * 588`。`channel_position(34_000_000, 10)` 返回 **-1482836259**，正确值 19992000221。它只在传纯 int 时出错，`user_positions()` 走的是 `int64`，所以平时看不出来。

两个都改成进门先转 `np.int64`，和模块里其他函数一致。

## 顺带查了同类

按「整数数组由 Python int 推断、再乘位常量」这个形状筛了一遍：`calib.py:176` 和 `imagedisc.py:137` 已经 `astype(float64)`，`cd.py:106/116/119` 显式 `np.int64`，`np.arange()` 用的是 `intp`，其余位运算都在 float64 上。所以包内只有上面两个函数符合，`np.zeros(..., int)` 之类也没有。

另外 `python -W error::RuntimeWarning -m discprobe selftest` 现在整个跑通（939 项），把剩下的整数溢出警告都变成失败也过了。

## 附带

修好之后本机 `selftest` 从「144 ok 后停在 CD timing ladder」变成 **939 ok、0 FAIL、all checks passed** —— 那条 `RuntimeError: no room for a rung 1.5 turns from the reference` 就是这个溢出造成的，不是独立 bug。`cd_selftest.py` 里加了三个断言，把两个函数在 2**31 以上的取值钉住。

## 这篇文章讲什么

新增 [《让光驱当量角器：disc-probe 自动标定的图解与推导》](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/blob/docs/auto-calibration-explained-20261107/docs/AUTO_CALIBRATION_EXPLAINED.md)，并在 README 文档表添加入口。

正文先讲直觉，主要公式跟在例子后面，较长推导和实现细节放进折叠区：

- 为什么“读取完成的时刻”包含角度信息，整圈等待为什么能被取模消掉。
- 怎样用相干幅度估计周期，随机等待解决什么、不能保证什么。
- 从薄圆环推导螺旋的地址—角度公式，以及稳定计算形式和解析导数。
- 阶梯如何逐级恢复整数圈；给出半圈误差条件的证明，并区分真实误差界与 25° 标准差门限。
- 带先验的 Gauss–Newton 拟合、协方差驱动的选点，以及秩一方差更新推导。
- 可选的变轨距固定点迭代、尺度和沿轨原点的不可观测性，以及地址相关延迟造成的混淆。

## 配图与证据

包含 6 张仓库内自包含 SVG：时间与相位、周期歧义、螺旋几何、整圈阶梯、可观测性限制、实盘验证。

title: 蓝光：只靠光驱计时解出盘片几何（实验性），并导出 DiscImageStudio 预设
body:
## 做了什么

蓝光是 CLV：读一个已知扇区所花的时间随它的半径增长。把这件事放到**周期空间**里拟合，
线速度就自己消掉了：

```
T(n)^2 = b + a*n          =>      b/a = pi * r0^2 / (p * S)
```

`r0` 是扇区 0 所在半径，`p` 是轨距，`S` 是每扇区字节数。右边没有速度项，所以驱动器的速度
准到 1% 也无所谓。把轨距锚在标准的 0.3200 µm 上，这个比值直接给出 `r0`，外径由扇区总数
推出。全程不拍照、不扫描、不手动选圆心：一条命令、约两分钟，数字直接写成
DiscImageStudio 预设。

- `discprobe/clv.py`：周期空间的 T² 拟合。Gauss-Newton，方差模型带两个系数的协方差，
  MAD 剔除坏区，加锁相谐波滤波。CAV 盘交给原来的角度梯子，而不是被一个不适用的拟合毁掉。
- `discprobe/timing.py`：分区采样（FUA 读）、plain/FUA 缓存对比、三处转速判定。
- `discprobe/geo.py`：蓝光路径先判模式和速度，CAV 盘在测 25 个区之前就被拦下。
- `discprobe/bdexport.py`：导出 DiscImageStudio 预设，含格式化 BD-RE 的 ISA0 备用区回推，
  以及压印 BD-ROM 的"这是个小盘、不是备用区"分支。
- `discprobe/calibdisc.py`：一张既能量自己、又能看出自己扭了多少的盘。
- 测试：`tests/test_bd_clv_solver.py` 27 项、`tests/test_bd_preset.py` 20 项、
  `python -m discprobe selftest` 全绿，都不碰图像匹配。

## 实测（这台光驱里的盘）

| 盘 | 扇区 | r0 | 1σ | R² | 区数 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 压印 BD-ROM | 12,218,368 | 24.0490 mm | 16.0 µm | 0.999996 | 23/25 |
| 刻录 BD-R 25 GB | 12,200,000 | 24.0655 mm | 20.4 µm | 0.999993 | 23/25 |
| 格式化 BD-RE | 12,088,320 | 24.6427 mm | -- | -- | -- |
| 同一张 BD-RE，扣除 ISA0 | 12,219,392 | 24.0485 mm | -- | -- | -- |

最后两行差 0.61 mm，正好是 131,072 扇区 = 4096 簇的内圈备用区，也就是格式化 BD-RE 藏起来
的那部分。扣回去之后和压印盘只差 0.5 µm，两者都落在格式允许的 24.00 ± 0.05 mm 里。
导出成预设时，压印盘的外径算出来是 58.0203 mm，DiscImageStudio 自带的 BD-25 预设是 58.0232 mm。

## 还没解决的（这条路线为什么标成实验性）

**轨距是先验，不是测量值。** 不给 `--linear-mm-s` 时它就是名义的 0.3200 µm，只负责把斜率
换成半径。

**内径挂在一个拟合看不见的固定计时偏置上。** `r0` 对读取开销的灵敏度是 1.43 µm/µs：
同一台光驱两种都说得通的读法之间差 54 µs，`r0` 就动 77 µm，而 R² 只在小数点后第五位变化。
拟合里没有任何统计量能分辨它们。

这不是纸上谈兵。同一张刻录 BD-R，计时给 24.0655 mm @ 0.3200 µm；同型号盘 burn-verified 的
预设是 23.9880 mm @ 0.32037 µm。两者在盘缘的半径只差 4 µm，角度却分道扬镳：50 万扇区处差
+20 圈，最后一个扇区差 **+106 圈**。拿计时预设去刻图案，出来就是二十几臂的螺旋——这正是
`calibdisc` 让人一眼看到的东西，也是为什么最后两个数必须来自盘本身，而不是来自这个拟合。

局限、三行预设对照表、以及"内径错/外径错/两者反向错"分别长什么样，写在
`docs/research/BD_CLV_GEOMETRY_SOLVER.md` §12 和 `docs/MANUAL.md` 里。

## 复现

```
python -m discprobe random --media bd --output iso/bd-random.iso     # 刻到 BD-R
python -m discprobe geo --drive G: --media bd --bd-zones 25
python -m discprobe disexport --geo latest --sectors <扇区数> --output dis_preset.json
```

---

## English summary

Blu-ray is CLV, so `T(n)^2 = b + a*n` in period space and `b/a = pi*r0^2/(p*S)` —
the linear speed cancels entirely. Anchoring the pitch at the 0.3200 um standard
turns the fit into an absolute inner radius; the sector count gives the rim. No
photo, no scanner, about two minutes, and `disexport` writes the result as a
DiscImageStudio preset.

Measured in this drive: a pressed BD-ROM comes out at r0 24.0490 mm (1 sigma
16.0 um, R^2 0.999996, 23 of 25 zones) with a rim at 58.0203 mm against the
58.0232 mm of the shipped preset; a formatted BD-RE reads 24.6427 mm, and pulling
back its 4096-cluster ISA0 spare area lands at 24.0485 mm, 0.5 um from the pressed
disc.

Both numbers that this cannot settle are stated in the docs rather than left to be
discovered: the pitch is an anchor, not a measurement, and r0 rides on a fixed
timing offset of 1.43 um per microsecond of read overhead, which no statistic in
the fit can see. On a burned BD-R the timing says 24.0655 mm at 0.3200 um where a
burn-verified preset for the same media says 23.9880 mm at 0.32037 um — the radii
agree to 4 um at the rim, the angles differ by 106 turns, and that is why the route
is marked experimental. `docs/research/BD_CLV_GEOMETRY_SOLVER.md` section 12 has
the tables; `docs/MANUAL.md` has the three edge shapes that say which radius is
wrong.

Tests: 27 in tests/test_bd_clv_solver.py, 20 in tests/test_bd_preset.py, plus
`python -m discprobe selftest`, none of which touch picture matching.

---

## 评审后变更（rebase 到 `6318db3` 之后）

- `OVERNIGHT_BD_SUMMARY.md` → `docs/research/BD_FIRST_DISC_NOTES.md`，并在开头纠正：24.677 mm 是格式化 BD-RE 的 4096 簇 ISA0 备用区，扣回后扇区 0 在 24.0485 mm（压印 BD-ROM 实测 24.0490 mm）。
- `iso/gen2-design.png`、`tools/experimental/`、`BD_SPOKE_SHEAR_REPORT.md` 移出本 PR，留在分支 `bd/gen2-photo-hold`（拍照路线单独提）。
- `python -m discprobe selftest` 现在会加载并运行 `tests/test_*.py`，每个文件报一行结果；全量 selftest 约 1 分 48 秒。
- 蓝光路径在 `-h` epilog、`guide`、两个 README 里都标为实验性，并写明：计时给的是螺旋的**形状**，不是**尺度**；比例要从盘上定，不能直接拿计时预设刻图（实测同盘半径差 4 µm、角度差 106 圈、图案会变成二三十条臂）。

title: tools: 离线验证 CD 沿轨常数不可测的三个脚本
body:
issue #13 里的第二个 PR：三个验证脚本。@Ashley-QwQ 在 [#13 (comment)](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/issues/13#issuecomment-6724002170) 里说放 `tools/`、开头写用法、依赖只用 numpy/scipy、结果尽量可重复。这个 PR 只加这三个文件。

## 做了什么

- `tools/cd_along_track_observability.py`：在合成相位上比较「数据整体平移 d 帧」和「换一个 r0」的拟合，打印拟合 r0、残差、每帧的 r0 位移，以及 `--along-track-frames` 的导出方向。`--noise-deg` 默认 0，`--seed` 默认 0。
- `tools/cd_refit_along_offset.py`：读一个完成的 `geo` `summary.json`，把每个 n 平移 d 帧后按同样的 fit 重拟合；打印 r0 斜率和残差是否变化。
- `tools/cd_along_track_speeds.py`：读两个或更多不同转速的 `summary.json`，拟合 `r0_eff^2 = r0^2 + k*(W+R0) + k*tau*v/b`，给出 slope、`tau` 和显著性。默认排除 `chi2/dof > 3` 的梯子（`--max-chi2-nu` 可调，0 关闭），表后打印排除了哪次、为什么；其余测量进入拟合前，r0 误差乘以 `sqrt(max(1, chi2/dof))`。只有两个转速时，结论后明说 sigma 只是形式值。
- 三个脚本开头都有 usage 和符号约定；只直接 import numpy（`discprobe` 自己的依赖不算新增）；唯一带噪声的检查默认固定种子。

## 为什么

#13 的结论是 C 与 r0 简并。这三个脚本把这句话变成可重跑的数：

- 合成：任何还能展开的 d 都拟合同样的 rms，r0 按 1.663 nm/帧移动；默认 8 个 offset 里，除 ±2000 帧（丢圈数，rms 89.8°）外 rms 都是 0，拟合斜率 +1.6630 nm/帧（解析 +1.6630）。
- 保存的 24 级梯子：±200 帧让 r0 移 0.314 µm，rms 仍是 0.310°。
- 两个转速（1241.1 / 2482.2 rpm）：`r0_eff` 差 5.7 帧，slope 0.8σ，`tau = -0.3 ± 0.4 µs`（误差按各梯子的 chi2/dof 放大）。这是 null，但正是想要的 null：C 是一个要写进预设的数，不是梯子能测的数。

## 验证

```powershell
python tools/cd_along_track_observability.py
python tools/cd_refit_along_offset.py results/geo-G-20261108-033459/summary.json --frames -200 200 9
python tools/cd_along_track_speeds.py results/geo-G-20261108-033459/summary.json results/geo-G-20261108-033747/summary.json
python tools/cd_along_track_speeds.py evidence/cd-geo-20261104/full-2080rpm/summary.json evidence/cd-geo-20261104/full/summary.json
```

前三条在本机 Python 3.12 / numpy 1.26 上跑通。第四条用仓库里的两次 CD 测量：3224 rpm 那次 `chi2/dof 38.4`，默认被排除，只剩一个转速；加 `--max-chi2-nu 0` 保留它时，slope 的显著性从 3.3σ 降到 0.5σ——3.3σ 来自坏数据，不是 C 的时间项。从当前 `main` + 这三个文件跑过，`py_compile` 通过。

文档（简并性证明 + 一张烧录盘的实测）在 #27（已合并）。

nodes.body:
@domerawind 谢谢！#27 已经合并了。

这三个脚本我都用仓库里的数据跑过：`cd_along_track_observability.py` 和 `cd_refit_along_offset.py` 都复现了你的结论。用我们 2080 rpm 那次 CD 实测，平移 −200 到 +200 帧，残差 rms 一直是 0.233°，只有 r0 线性移动。

`cd_along_track_speeds.py` 有一处想请你改一下再合并：它不看每次测量的质量。我拿 `evidence/cd-geo-20261104/` 里的两次 CD 测量去跑：

```
full-2080rpm   2078 rpm   rms 0.233°   chi2/dof  1.48
full           3224 rpm   rms 1.210°   chi2/dof 38.42
```

脚本报告“斜率偏离 0 有 3.3σ，C 随读取速度变化”。但 3224 rpm 那次正是 README 里写着不能用的那次（49.8 mm 以外完成时刻晚约 0.2 ms），chi2/dof 38，它的 r0 误差也就严重偏小了。所以这个 3.3σ 来自坏数据，而不是来自 C。

建议二选一，或者都做：

- chi2/dof 明显大于 1（比如大于 3）的测量默认排除，并在输出里说明排除了哪次、为什么；
- 用每次的 r0 误差之前先乘上 √(chi2/dof)，再算斜率的显著性。

另外，结论那句如果只有两次测量，最好说明“两点只能给出斜率，给不出误差的可靠估计”，免得读者把两点的结果当成定论。

谢谢实测，3.3σ 确实是 3224 rpm 那次的 chi2/dof 38.4 撑出来的。已按建议改了两处，并加了第三点：

- 默认排除 `chi2/dof > 3` 的测量，表里标 `(excluded: ...)`，表后说明排除了哪次、为什么；`--max-chi2-nu N` 可调，`0` 关闭。
- 其余测量进入拟合前，r0 误差乘以 `sqrt(max(1, chi2/dof))`。
- 只有两个转速时，结论后明确写：两点只定义斜率，sigma 是形式值，不能检验两次测量是否一致；第三次测量才能给出可靠误差。

用 `evidence/cd-geo-20261104/` 的两次测量验证：

- 默认：`full`（3224 rpm）被排除，只剩 `full-2080rpm`；输出说明单转速无法分离 r0 与 C。
- `--max-chi2-nu 0`：保留两次，slope 从 3.3σ 降到 **0.5σ**，`tau = +0.002 ± 0.004 ms`。
- 我们 11-08 的两次（chi2/dof 2.66 / 0.50）仍在拟合内，slope 1.2σ → **0.8σ**，结论不变。

PR 已 rebase 到当前 `main` 并更新（`98fea10`）。

title: docs: CD 沿轨常数为什么测不到（简并性证明 + 一张烧录盘的实测）
body:
issue #13 的第 6 节问过文档要不要收；@Ashley-QwQ 在 [#13 (comment)](https://github.com/Ashley-QwQ/disc-probe/issues/13#issuecomment-6724002170) 里说文档放 `docs/research/CD_GEOMETRY_INVESTIGATION.md`。这个 PR 只按那个位置放文档，不改代码。

## 做了什么

- `docs/research/CD_GEOMETRY_INVESTIGATION.md`：证明把读结束位置整体平移 C 帧，与把内半径换成 `sqrt(r0^2 + p*L*C/pi)`（`L` = 一帧的轨道长度 0.1633 mm）是**同一个拟合**。30 级梯子（LBA 5000..150000）、p = 1.6 µm、C = 206 帧，两边最大差 8.3e-10 度；在 25 mm 处每帧只动 1.663 nm 的 r0，206 帧是 0.343 µm。所以 `geo` 只能测到 `r0 + C`。文档还写了 ATIP 的 ±0.15 mm ≈ 9 万帧、DVD 为什么没有这个参数，以及哪些路线还能给出绝对数。
- `docs/research/CD_ALONG_TRACK_CALIBRATION.md`：11-08 烧的一张 348,634 扇区网格盘（`iso/cd-grid.iso`，sha256 见文档）上的后续实验。一张盘、两种转速、各 24 级梯子：`r0_eff` 差 **5.7 ± 4.7 帧**，与 0 一致；并论证任何数据布局都带不出 C，只能做差或给上下界。光学那一步这次没拍到（§5a），下一张盘要换 `--cd-sector mode1` + 8x。
- 按回复补了一段：C = W + R，所以光驱偏移表要按「刻录机 + 刻录模式 + 读取光驱」组合记，不能只按读取光驱型号。
- `--along-track-frames` 按现状写：它是外部输入，`geo` 不拟合它，只有 `image` 和 `disexport` 接收。
- 开头有中文摘要；正文保留英文推导、命令和实测输出。

## 验证

- 等式在本地重算：30 级 LBA 5000..150000、p = 1.6 µm、C = 206 帧 → 最大差 8.3e-10 度；r0 位移 0.343 µm = 1.663 nm/帧。
- 文档里的命令都用仓库现有代码跑过。
- `python -m discprobe selftest` 在 `a449e22` 上通过（all checks passed）。

title: geo: clip rung targets about their median; a replay tool for finished runs
body:
Narrowed as suggested in the comments below: the median-centred clip for `geo`'s rung phase, and `tools/geo_reanalyse.py` with its period fix. The line drift and the sem change are no longer in `geo`.

## A correction to #7

In #7 I wrote that `robust_circular_mean` "clips only the targets", so reference outliers reach the targets. That was wrong: `estimate_period` already clips the reference reads at 5×MAD about their median. The real cause is in how the targets are clipped.

On the BU20N, about 10–12 % of target reads come back late by 4–60°, mostly 10–20° (1.3–2.7 ms at 48 ms per turn). Early ones are rare. Here are the target reads by their offset from the rung's median, on the two CD audio runs from #7:

| | below −4° | ±4° | +4…+20° | above +20° |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| banana | 17 | 993 | 124 | 18 |
| POSO | 1 | 1028 | 110 | 13 |

The circular mean follows that tail: per rung it sits 1.2–1.3° (median) after the median, up to 5.3°. The MAD about that shifted mean is wider, so the 5×MAD window keeps part of the tail. How much it keeps varies from rung to rung, and that becomes rung-to-rung noise in the fit.

## What changes

- **`geo`:** `Ladder.measure` calls the new `analysis.robust_median_mean` on the same `phase_offsets` as before. The targets are clipped at 4×MAD (at least 1.5°) about their median, then averaged on the circle. The sem is σ/√N, as before.
- **Unchanged:** `timing`'s phase step, `robust_circular_mean` and `phase_offsets`.
- **`tools/geo_reanalyse.py`:** recomputes a finished run's rungs from `events.csv` and refits, without a new measurement. It prints three rows:
  - **interp:** what `geo` did before.
  - **median:** what `geo` does now.
  - **line:** not in `geo`. It takes the reference drift from a line through the block's reference reads and adds the line's uncertainty to the sem. I kept it in the tool only, so more runs can be compared against an independent reference.

## The replay tool's period fix

The tool gave every block the summary's final period as the prior. A run whose period changes partway couldn't be rebuilt (Ashley's WH14NS40 run, 158.6° off). Now:

- Each block's prior is its rung's own `period_ms` from `targets.csv`.
- A sector read in more than one block (a retry, or a check point that is also a rung) uses the block whose period is the recorded one.
- The rebuild check names the estimator the run was made with: `interp` for runs made before this change, `median` for runs made since.

I don't have a run whose period changes, so I tested it this way: on a simulated run made with this branch (check points on), I multiplied the summary's period by 1.57. The old tool comes out 179.8° off; this one rebuilds to 0.000°.

## Numbers

Both runs are BU20N CD audio ladders from #7. `d ri`/`d ro` are against the C# probe's independent calibration of the same disc.

| run | estimator | median σ (°) | χ²/dof | rms (°) | d ri (nm) | d ro (nm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| banana | interp (before) | 0.464 | 3.01 | 1.238 | +5.0 | −4.2 |
| | **median (after)** | 0.238 | 2.06 | **0.479** | −2.0 | −0.3 |
| | line (tool only) | 0.254 | 1.55 | 0.490 | −3.4 | −0.1 |
| POSO | interp (before) | 0.379 | 2.80 | 1.078 | −3.5 | +2.4 |
| | **median (after)** | 0.202 | 2.23 | **0.341** | −2.5 | +1.9 |
| | line (tool only) | 0.224 | 1.46 | 0.311 | −2.6 | +0.9 |

- **The median clip gives the gain:** the rms drops 2.5–3×, and ri and ro move by a few nm.
- **The line only improves χ²:** it doesn't bring ri and ro closer to the C# values. That matches the DVD runs in the comments below, so it stays out.

On the simulator the median clip changes nothing within the seed-to-seed scatter. Its outliers are 1 % of reads spread over 0.3–3 ms, so it has no tail like the BU20N's. Over seeds 7–42 of the two `_ladder` scenarios (run on the previous base, db322e3), the median peak-to-peak error is:

| scenario | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| plain | 1.40° | 1.55° |
| texture rings | 1.24° | 1.41° |

## Selftest

One new check, `_phase_tail`, which needs no numpy. It builds 20 synthetic rungs like the BU20N's: 32 pairs, 100/140 µs scatter, and 12 % of targets 4–20° late. Clipped about the median, the mean error is +0.10° and the rms 0.30°; about the circular mean they are +0.81° and 1.21°. No existing check changes.

`docs/AUTO_CALIBRATION_EXPLAINED.md` says how `geo` clips.

## Tested

- `selftest` with Blender's Python (numpy, no scipy or Pillow), on current main (1353f14): every check up to the first scipy-only one (`_pitch_fit`) passes, including the new one.
- I then called the later numpy-section checks one by one. Every one that can run without scipy or Pillow passes. Those that go through `geo`:
  - `_ladder`: plain 1.279°, the check points, texture rings 0.266°;
  - `_ladder_safe_unwrap` and `_ladder_abort`;
  - the `_ladder_cd_audio` rungs: ri +1 nm, ro −1 nm, χ² 1.20;
  - `_geo_rotation`;
  - `cd_selftest`'s timing ladder: four geometries, 0.15–0.19°.
- Not run here: what imports scipy or Pillow. A full `selftest` on your side would cover it:
  - `disexport`, which also stops the end of `_ladder_cd_audio`, `_install_details` and `_correction_run`;
  - two `tests/` files and `_tiles`;
  - the scan, ring and cal selftests;
  - part of `ui_selftest`.
- `tools/geo_reanalyse.py`:
  - the two #7 runs, made before this change: `interp` rebuilds to 0.000°;
  - a simulated run made with this branch, check points on: `median` rebuilds to 0.000°;
  - the tampered-period test above.

@WindowsNoEditor Thanks for this, and for writing up the correction about #7 so clearly. You asked us to check it on our DVD runs before deciding, so we did. `tools/geo_reanalyse.py` reproduced every recorded run exactly (rebuild check 0.000°), which made this easy.

We ran it on five GH70N runs of two RITEKF1 DVD-R discs. Two are clean. The other three are of one disc on an evening when the drive was in an odd state (single-shot scatter about three times its usual, cause still unknown), so they're a stress test rather than a typical run:

| run | before: χ²/dof, rms | median | line (this PR) |
|---|---|---|---|
| clean A | 0.31, 0.103° | 0.27, 0.096° | 0.26, 0.098° |
| clean B | 0.23, 0.116° | 0.19, 0.080° | 0.22, 0.088° |
| noisy 1 | 1.69, 0.501° | 1.46, 0.262° | 0.73, 0.306° |
| noisy 2 | 1.57, 0.401° | 1.38, 0.272° | 0.99, 0.327° |
| noisy 3 | 1.82, 0.421° | 1.73, 0.346° | 1.03, 0.343° |

So the fit looks better everywhere, and χ² comes to about 1 on the noisy runs, as on your BU20N. But the three noisy runs are of the same disc as clean A, so we can also ask whether they land closer to clean A's geometry. Peak-to-peak angle difference from clean A over 24.5–58 mm:

| run | before | median | line |
|---|---|---|---|
| noisy 1 | 0.637° | 0.532° | 0.550° |
| noisy 2 | 0.771° | 0.827° | 0.960° |
| noisy 3 | 0.503° | 0.500° | 0.741° |
| clean B (other disc, same pack) | 0.124° | — | 0.085° |

On these, the median clip alone is about neutral, and the line drift moves two of the three further from the clean answer by about 0.2°. We don't think this shows the line is wrong. Those runs have their own trouble, and their differences from clean A are larger than anything here. But it's the only DVD evidence we have, and it doesn't show the gain your CD runs do.

Would you be open to one of these?

- Split it: take the median-centred clip and the honest sem now, and keep the line drift for when there's more data on CAV DVD drives.
- Or keep the line, but use it only when the reference residuals actually show a trend in the block (a slope test), and fall back to the neighbours otherwise.

If you see something in these numbers we're missing, say so. Your read of the BU20N tail was a clear catch, and we'd like to keep that part either way.

@WindowsNoEditor One more thing, found while replaying a different run: a WH14NS40 DVD run whose spindle period changed partway through.

`tools/geo_reanalyse.py` gives every block the same period prior, the summary's final period, with a ±2 % window (lines 96–104):

```python
period = (fit0.get("period_ms") or float(targets[0]["period_ms"])) / 1e3
...
fit = analysis.estimate_period(ref_t, prior_s=period, prior_window=0.02)
```

That run's first three accepted rungs were at 6.47 ms and the summary says 10.15 ms. So those blocks couldn't be fitted, and the `interp` rebuild came out 158.6° off instead of 0. The five GH70N runs above didn't hit this because the period stayed put within each run. With each rung's own `period_ms` from `targets.csv` as the prior, all 22 rungs rebuild to 0.000°.

With that change, the three estimators on that run:

| | χ²/dof | rms |
|---|---|---|
| interp (as recorded) | 2.41 | 0.288° |
| median | 2.42 | 0.289° |
| line | 2.62 | 0.304° |

There's no optical truth for this disc, so this only says the line model gave no gain on that run either, not that it made the picture worse.

What I'd suggest:
1. The replay fix (prior from each rung's `period_ms`) and the median clip as one PR. The clip looks neutral to slightly helpful everywhere so far, and it's easy to review.
2. The line reference and the SEM change kept apart until there's a case where they move a run closer to an independent reference, not only a better χ². The SEM change is a real improvement in what it reports. We'd just call it a conditional SEM in the docs: it still leaves out time-correlated errors and shared biases.

Happy to help with either. Thanks again for the replay tool, it made all of this cheap to check (◍•ᴗ•◍)

@Ashley-QwQ Thanks for running it on the DVD runs, and for the replay bug. I agree with the split in your second comment, and I've pushed it: one commit on current main, replacing the old one.

**In the PR now**

- `geo` clips the targets about their median (`robust_median_mean`), on the same neighbour-interpolated `phase_offsets` as before. The sem is σ/√N, as before.
- The replay fix: each block's prior is its rung's own `period_ms` from `targets.csv`.
  - Since main now reads check points with the same labels, a sector with more than one block uses the block whose period is the recorded one.
  - The rebuild check names the estimator the run was made with (`interp` for older runs, `median` for new ones).
  - I don't have a run whose period changes. On a simulated run with the summary's period multiplied by 1.57, the old tool is 179.8° off and this one rebuilds to 0.000°. If your WH14NS40 run still gives 0.000° with this version, that would confirm it.

**Out of `geo`**

- The line reference and the sem change. The existing texture-ring check keeps its 1.5°, so the selftest change I'd made for the line is gone too.
- I kept `line` as a third row in `tools/geo_reanalyse.py` only, so more runs can be checked against an independent reference. Say if you'd rather not have it in the tool either.

**Your numbers**

I don't see anything you're missing. My two CD runs say the same once I compare against the C# probe's calibration instead of χ². All of the rms gain is the median clip, and the line doesn't move ri/ro closer:

| | median, d ri / d ro | line, d ri / d ro |
|---|---|---|
| banana | −2.0 / −0.3 nm | −3.4 / −0.1 nm |
| POSO | −2.5 / +1.9 nm | −2.6 / +0.9 nm |

So I have no case yet where the line helps against an independent reference. If the sem change comes back later, I'll describe it as a conditional sem, as you suggest.

The PR description is rewritten to match.

@WindowsNoEditor Thanks for the quick and tidy split. I checked the new commit (81b00b7) on our data, and it works.

**The run whose speed changed.** This is sanitysama's WH14NS40 run from DiscImageStudio #171. The first three rungs are at 6.47 ms and the rest at 10.15 ms. With this version, all 22 rungs rebuild to 0.000°. That run also covers the multi-block case you mentioned: one sector was read twice, once while the spindle was still changing speed (that attempt failed) and once after it settled. The tool picked the second read, the one whose period matches the recorded 10.14647 ms. The three rows match what I posted earlier:

| | χ²/dof | rms |
|---|---|---|
| interp (as recorded) | 2.41 | 0.288° |
| median | 2.42 | 0.289° |
| line | 2.62 | 0.304° |

**The five GH70N runs** from my first comment: all rebuild to 0.000°, and every number is the same as before. I also tried two newer GH70N runs that read their check points twice. They rebuild to 0.000° as well.

**Checks:** `python -m discprobe selftest` passes (the new late-reads check gives +0.10° mean error and 0.30° rms, against +0.81° and 1.21° for the old clip), and the 49 tests pass.

Keeping `line` as a third row in the tool is fine with us. It makes it easy to look again when there's a run with an independent reference.

From our side this is ready to merge. Thanks again for the BU20N catch and the replay tool (◍•ᴗ•◍)

title: feat(linux): merge support for Linux platform from bczhc/disc-probe
body:
## 概要

本 PR 基于 [@bczhc](https://github.com/bczhc) 的 Linux 适配移植工作，将 [bczhc/disc-probe](https://github.com/bczhc/disc-probe) 的更改合入主仓库。合入后，同一份代码可以在 Windows（SPTI / IMAPI2）和 Linux（SG_IO）上驱动真实光驱。

本 PR 的第一个提交标注了 bczhc 为原始作者，注明了出处和冲突处理方式。在此感谢 @bczhc 的工作与贡献。

## 改动

- **后端**：新增 `discprobe/sg.py`（经 `ioctl(SG_IO)` 访问 `/dev/srN`，内核报 `EBUSY` 时改用对应的 `/dev/sgN`）和 `discprobe/device.py`（按平台选择后端）。Linux 上提权使用 `SCHED_FIFO` 并绑定一个 CPU，失败时退回 `nice -20`。
- **sg 修复**：检查 host/driver status；driver sense 按 CHECK CONDITION 上报，未就绪和取盘的处理能正常触发；按 `resid` 截断返回数据；CDB 长度限制在 1–16 字节。新增 `sg_selftest`，用 mock 的 ioctl 测试，不需要光驱。
- **CLI / guide**：`list`、`info`、`timing`、`geo` 统一检查平台；`--drive` 接受 `/dev/sr0`、`sr0`、`/dev/sg0`；Linux 上拒绝 `--transport spti|imapi`；guide 在 Linux 上给出 growisofs / xorriso 刻录命令；timer-tick 诊断只在 Windows 上输 出。
- **文档**：README 和 MANUAL（中英文）加入 Linux 说明，并整合了原 `README-linux.md` 的内容。
- **Windows 行为不变**：SPTI 被拒时回退 IMAPI2 的逻辑保持原样。

## 测试

- Linux：`python -m discprobe selftest` 全部通过（1167 项，含 `sg_selftest`）。
- Linux 实机（SATA 光驱，DVD-R）：
  - `cdrom` 组普通用户：`list`、`info`、`timing`、`geo` 正常。
  - root 下 `SCHED_FIFO` 提权成功。
  - 盘被挂载时可以直接打开 `/dev/sr0`。
  - `--drive /dev/sgN` 可用。
  - `timing` 运行中按弹出键，程序报未就绪后干净退出。
- Windows 实机：`info`、`timing` 等命令输出正常。

## 未测试

- Linux 刻 CD 图案的流程（`--cd-sector` 与 cdrecord / xorriso 写入格式是否匹配），文档中已注明。
- Linux 上的 USB 光驱：只有 bczhc 原有的数据。

## 已知小问题

Linux 上给 `timing` 传错 `--transport` 时，会先打印一行无关的 "could not raise process priority"，然后才报参数错误。但不影响程序主要结果。

---

## Summary

Merges the Linux port by [@bczhc](https://github.com/bczhc) from [bczhc/disc-probe](https://github.com/bczhc/disc-probe), so the same code drives real optical drives on Windows (SPTI / IMAPI2) and Linux (SG_IO). The first commit keeps bczhc as author and notes where the work came from and how conflicts were resolved. Thanks for @bczhc's original contributions.

## Changes

- **Backend**: adds `discprobe/sg.py` (`ioctl(SG_IO)` on `/dev/srN`, switching to the matching `/dev/sgN` when the kernel returns `EBUSY`) and `discprobe/device.py` (picks the backend for the platform). On Linux, priority is raised with `SCHED_FIFO` pinned to one CPU, falling back to `nice -20`.
- **sg fixes**: checks host/driver status; reports driver sense as CHECK CONDITION, so not-ready and media-removal handling fires; truncates returned data to `resid`; limits CDBs to 1–16 bytes. Adds `sg_selftest`, which uses a mocked ioctl and needs no drive.
- **CLI / guide**: one platform check for `list`, `info`, `timing`, `geo`; `--drive` accepts `/dev/sr0`, `sr0`, `/dev/sg0`; `--transport spti|imapi` is refused on Linux; on Linux, guide gives growisofs / xorriso burn commands; the timer-tick diagnosis only shows on Windows.
- **Docs**: README and MANUAL (zh/en) cover Linux and take in the content of the former `README-linux.md`.
- **Windows behaviour unchanged**: the fallback from SPTI to IMAPI2 when SPTI is refused works as before.

## Testing

- Linux: `python -m discprobe selftest` passes (1167 checks, including `sg_selftest`).
- Linux, real hardware (SATA drive, DVD-R):
  - As a regular user in the `cdrom` group: `list`, `info`, `timing`, `geo` work.
  - As root, raising priority with `SCHED_FIFO` works.
  - `/dev/sr0` opens while the disc is mounted.
  - `--drive /dev/sgN` works.
  - Pressing eject during `timing` makes it report not-ready and exit cleanly.
- Windows, real hardware: `info`, `timing` and other commands produce the expected output.

## Not tested

- Burning CD pictures from Linux (whether `--cd-sector` matches what cdrecord / xorriso write); the docs say so.
- USB drives on Linux: only bczhc's earlier measurements.

## Known nit

On Linux, passing a wrong `--transport` to `timing` first prints an unrelated "could not raise process priority" line before the argument error. It doesn't affect the main results.

title: disexport --install：可自定义 DiscImageStudio 预设的 id 与显示名称
body:
## 背景

`disexport --install` 之前只能装成固定的预设 id 和名称（如 `discprobe-bd-re` / `BD-RE (drive-timing calibration)`）。`--id` / `--name` 两个选项从最初的 `disexport` 就存在，也会写进 CD/DVD 与蓝光两类预设，但 `--help` 里只有两个光秃秃的 `--id ID` / `--name NAME`，手册里没有提，也没有写入前的校验和测试。

DiscImageStudio 用 id 区分预设：同一个 id 会命中已有预设（要改取值得加 `--replace`）；与内置预设同 id 会整条覆盖那条内置预设。显示名称则是预设列表里展示的文字。两者都应该能显式指定。

## 改动

- **写入前校验**：新增 `disinstall.check_identity()`，去掉 id/名称首尾空白，拒绝空 id、空名称和保留 id `__manual__`。此前仅导出（`--output`）时这些值会原样写进 JSON，DiscImageStudio 会因此拒绝整个预设文件；现在会在写任何文件之前报错。安装路径原本由 `_validate_preset` 兜底，这里补上首尾空白处理并让错误更早出现。
- **帮助与中文**：补全 `--id` / `--name` 的帮助文案和 `zh.py` 翻译；安装输出改为 `'id' ("显示名")`，装完就能看到预设列表里会显示什么，中文界面下同样翻译（如 `已把预设 'my-bd-re'（“BD-RE 威宝 25G”）加入 …`）。
- **文档**：`docs/MANUAL.md`、`docs/MANUAL.en.md`、`README.md`、`README.en.md` 补上默认值、改名方式（同 id + `--replace`）以及“与内置预设同 id 会整条覆盖内置项”的警告；蓝光部分还说明不加 `--install` 时文件名按 `--name` 取，因为 DIS 导入时拿文件名当预设名。
- **测试**：`selftest.py` 覆盖 id/名称校验；`ui_selftest.py` 覆盖自定义 id + 中文名称安装、首尾空白裁剪、仅导出路径、中文安装行，以及空值 / `__manual__` 被拒且不落盘。

## 用法

```sh
python -m discprobe disexport --geo results/geo-G-20261108-052047 --sectors 12088320 \
  --install --id my-bd-re --name "BD-RE 威宝 25G"
```

输出：

```
Added preset 'my-bd-re' ("BD-RE 威宝 25G") to .../disc-presets.json
```

同一个 id 再次安装并加 `--replace` 即可更新取值或改名；换一个新 id 则并列新增一条预设。默认值保持不变。

## 验证

- `python -m discprobe selftest`：all checks passed
- 用真实 BD-RE 结果安装实测，id 与名称首尾空白被去掉
- `--id __manual__`、空 `--name` 均以退出码 1 拒绝且不写文件
- `python -m discprobe disexport -h --lang zh` 中文帮助与中文安装输出正常

## 兼容性

默认值保持不变，现有命令行为不变；只有显式给出 `--id` / `--name` 时才使用新值。

nodes.body:
谢谢！这个功能原来就有但谁都找不到，现在帮助、手册、校验和测试都补齐了，输出里还直接显示预设名，用起来清楚多了。

我在本地跑了 `selftest`（全部通过）和 `pytest tests`（47 项通过），跟现在的 main 合并也没有冲突。还对照了 DIS 的 `DISC_PRESETS.md`：同 id 盖过内置预设、id 只需在同组内唯一、`__manual__` 保留，这几点和你写的一致。

有两处小地方想请你改一下：

1. `--id` 的帮助（中英文）写的是"文件里已有的 id 会更新那条预设"。实际上取值不同时，不加 `--replace` 会被拒绝。手册里这句写对了（"值不同要加 `--replace`"），帮助里也补上吧，比如：
   `an id already in the file is updated only with --replace when its values differ`

title: feat(console): guided console for the disc workflow
body:
## What this adds

`python -m discprobe menu` opens a full-screen guided console for the DVD/CD/BD workflow; a bare `python -m discprobe` at a terminal opens it too. `guide` and piped/scripted output are unchanged.

- one place for each step: what it is for, how long it takes, the exact command; `r` runs it, `e` edits it, `c` copies it
- `:` fuzzy command palette built from the real argparse parser, with help; `?` keys; `m` disc type; `l` language
- picture form with drag-and-drop path cleanup and Tab completion
- selected-row/keycap backgrounds and clickable results-folder/manual links (OSC 8); reverse-video fallback, plain output when colour or ANSI is off
- numbered fallback when the terminal cannot deliver keys; the console leaves the alternate screen before running a command, so progress animations and games still work

## Implementation notes

- zero new dependencies: pure stdlib escape sequences, no prompt_toolkit/rich
- `guide.py` now exposes structured `Task`/`Plan`; `guide_lines` stays byte-identical for scripts
- `menu` is added next to `guide`; no-arg interactive start switches to it
- the opening disc animation still plays before the console opens
- Windows: keyboard and links; SGR mouse/wheel where the terminal delivers mouse events

## Verification

- `python -m discprobe selftest`: all checks passed, including the new `guided console` checks
- `python -m discprobe menu -h` and top-level `-h` work; `menu` in a pipe prints the plain guide lines

title: feat(guide): read the blank disc's available sectors
body:
## 为什么

默认流程漏掉了空盘 `info` 这一步，但标定和 `disexport --sectors` 都需要空盘报告的可用扇区数。原来 `guide` 和引导控制台从 `list` 直接走到随机数据盘。

## 改了什么

- 在 `list` 之后、随机数据盘之前加入 **Blank disc (info)** 步骤；`guide`、清单、编号回退和 TUI 控制台同时生效。
- 步骤上显示读到的数量（如 `2,295,104 sectors available`），并带进下一条随机盘提示。
- 只有**同盘型的空盘**报告才会打勾：刻过的盘读回来的数可能偏大；`incomplete`（写了一半、未封盘）不算空盘；CD 的 ATIP 导出口、以及没有 track 空闲块的空 BD 容量仍算空盘容量。
- 已经做过随机盘或 `timing` 的用户不会被拉回这一步：清单里它保持未做，但不挡后面的步骤，也不标“现在到这里”，下一条命令直接做图片 ISO。
- `info` 结果按 CD/DVD/BD 盘型筛选，不会拿另一种盘的报告打勾。
- 教程改为 6 步；README 中英文和两份手册同步更新。
- 非交互脚本现在看到 6 个默认步骤（多出空盘检查这一行），这是有意的。

## 验证

- `python -m discprobe selftest` -> `all checks passed`
- 新增测试覆盖：DVD 报告不勾 BD 步骤、`incomplete` 盘不算空盘、已做 timing/geo 的用户不回到 info、空 BD 容量回退。
- `python -m discprobe guide` 第一条命令现在是 `python -m discprobe info --drive ...`。
- `python -m discprobe menu` 从新的空盘步骤开始。

基于 #32 合并后的最新 `main`。
